svg.title: Chatham V: interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Two joined monochrome panels forming an inverted L. Approximate geometry, interpretive screen palette, transparent background. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for red, blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moma.org/d/pdfs/W1siZiIsIjIwMTgvMDYvMTMvOGlvazUweWl5aF9LZWxseV9DaGF0aGFtX1BSRVZJRVcxLnBkZiJdXQ/Kelly_Chatham_PREVIEW1.pdf?sha=cc613fbfe3ec18ec; reviewed 2026-10-26; interpretive reconstruction, not a facsimile.
